subject: Catalyze onsite: calendar holds, arrival corridors and transit buffer plan
messages:
From: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwoodai.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodai.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodai.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodai.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Catalyze onsite: calendar holds, arrival corridors and transit buffer plan

Team —

We have Catalina/Catalyze exec immersion scheduled the week of Dec 14. Ava asked for a compact in-person agenda (exec + platform deep-dive) that still respects their execs' travel windows. Before I touch the customer with hard times, I want internal alignment on:

1) Recommended calendar holds (two-day core onsite + 1 shadow day) by role: Exec brief (day 1 AM), Platform deep-dive (day 1 PM), Ops/Integrations (day 2 AM), War room + next steps (day 2 PM).

2) Arrival corridors: we should request arrivals the evening before for execs (preferred) or the morning of with an earliest-in-window of 8:30am local. Leave a 90–120m transit buffer for LGA traffic and hotel shuttles — propose we block 10:30–12:30 on Day 0 as contingency for late arrivals ("arrival corridor").

3) Local staffing: need SE on-site (Monica), field eng backup (Priyom), and room ops/AV point (Rachel). Monica — can you confirm you can lead day 1? Priyom — standby for preflight testing and the morning of day 2. Rachel — I'll need exact AV checklist and seating layout by EOD Monday so we can lock the room.

4) Calendar holds we will send to Catalyze should be soft holds for now: two 4-hour blocks per day with timezones converted to ET (customer is Boston/BOS). I'll propose:
   - Tue Dec 15 09:00–13:00 ET — Exec + intro
   - Tue Dec 15 14:00–17:00 ET — Platform deep-dive
   - Wed Dec 16 09:00–13:00 ET — Integrations + workshops
   - Wed Dec 16 14:00–17:00 ET — War room / next steps

Attached is version 0 of a schedule (Catalyze_MA_schedule_v1.xlsx) and a quick room layout suggestion (room_layout_A_2up.pdf).

Ask: Please reply with any redlines to the arrival corridor durations, staffing conflicts, or AV constraints. If we agree, I'll share soft calendar holds with Catalyze and propose the arrival corridor language to their execs.

Thanks —
Lukas
Lukas Meyer
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
luke@redwoodai.com | +1 415 555 0192
[Attachment: Catalyze_MA_schedule_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)]
[Attachment: room_layout_A_2up.pdf (pdf)]

From: Ava Lin <ava.lin@catalyze.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwoodai.com>
Cc: Catalyze Executive Team <execs@catalyze.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 12:05:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Catalyze onsite: calendar holds, arrival corridors and transit buffer plan

Lukas —

Thanks for the clear plan. The proposed blocks look good overall. A few notes from our side:

- Execs prefer arriving the evening prior when possible; however, one of our VPs is transiting from the west coast and would arrive morning of Dec 15 (around 9:30–10:00 ET).
- Prefer shorter transit buffers for our on-site schedule; 90 minutes is fine if that covers pickup time plus a 15–30 min buffer.
- Headcount: Execs (4), Product (2), Platform (1) — total on-site ~7 on day 1; additional 6 for integrations day.
- AV: we'll need a single presenter laptop feed + live captions; please confirm Redwood can provide captions and record the main sessions.
- Meals: light boxed lunch both days and coffee on arrival.

If you can send the soft calendar holds today, we’ll accept and circulate internally. Also, can you confirm whether Redwood will arrange car service from BOS to the hotel and back? If not, we’ll handle transfers and share ETA windows separately.

Regards,
Ava Lin
Head of Customer Experience, Catalyze
ava.lin@catalyze.com

Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 13:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Catalyze onsite: calendar holds, arrival corridors and transit buffer plan

Lukas / team —

I can take AV lead. Quick checklist and notes:

- AV checklist: 1x HDMI+USB-C presenter feed, 1x backup HDMI, room mics for panel (3), live-captioning via vendor (we can use Redwood cloud captions, need permission from customer to record).
- Room layout: I recommend theatre rows for exec brief (day 1 AM), then pod tables for breakout (day 2 AM). PDF attached shows a 2-up layout for the same footprint.
- Timing: 90–120m transit buffer is ok for evening arrivals; if the VP arrives at 9:30–10:00 ET we should plan for a soft touchpoint at 10:30 local to get them settled before the intro at 11:00 (we can shift the exec brief start to 11:00 that morning if needed).
- Catering: Monica — can you confirm boxed lunch provider (vegan + gluten-free options) and confirm headcount?
- Booking: I'll open a room ops ticket with facilities and request the AV cart + an on-call engineer for both days.

Forwarding Ava's availability below so we can finalize holds.

—Rachel
Rachel Kim
Events & Room Operations, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: room_layout_A_2up.pdf (pdf)]

From: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwoodai.com>
To: Ava Lin <ava.lin@catalyze.com>, Catalyze Executive Team <execs@catalyze.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodai.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodai.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodai.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 13:05:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Catalyze onsite: calendar holds, arrival corridors and transit buffer plan

Ava / team —

Thanks — we’ll send soft holds now and follow up with exact AV/catering logistics next week. Summary and next steps:

1) Soft calendar holds (sent):
   - Tue Dec 15 11:00–15:00 ET — Exec + intro (shifted to accommodate 9:30 arrival)
   - Tue Dec 15 15:30–17:30 ET — Platform deep-dive (shortened to leave travel buffer)
   - Wed Dec 16 09:00–13:00 ET — Integrations + workshops
   - Wed Dec 16 14:00–17:00 ET — War room / next steps

2) Arrival corridors: Evening prior preferred. For the one VP arriving morning of Dec 15 we’ve shifted the exec brief to 11:00 to provide margin.

3) Transfers: Redwood can arrange car service for key execs on request. I’ve provisionally booked a one-way car for VP arrival (car_service_stub.txt attached) — Monica, Priyom, please confirm and I’ll finalize with vendor.

4) Recording & captions: Rachel confirmed Redwood cloud captioning is available; Ava, we need written permission to record the main sessions (I included DocuSign link in related_links for a single-session recording consent).

5) Attachments: final v1 schedule (Catalyze_MA_schedule_v1.xlsx), room layout (room_layout_A_2up.pdf), car service stub (car_service_stub.txt). I’ll update the schedule to v1.1 after we get headcount and catering.

If no objections, we’ll mark holds in 30 minutes and loop in facilities and vendor contacts.

Best,
Lukas
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Catalyze_MA_schedule_v1.xlsx]
